sql.sql:
WITH eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT c.entity_id id,c.embedding_id,e.seq FROM chunks c JOIN entities e ON e.id=c.entity_id
      WHERE c.type=? AND c.index_name=? AND c.generation=? AND c.embedding_id IS NOT NULL
      AND c.entity_id IN (SELECT p.id FROM (SELECT p.* FROM index_builds b CROSS JOIN field_index x CROSS JOIN (SELECT e.id,0 major,e.seq ord FROM entities e WHERE e.type=? AND e.trashed=0) p
              WHERE b.type IN ('Row') AND b.name=? AND b.kind='value' AND b.state='ready'
              AND x.type=b.type AND x.field=b.name AND x.generation=b.generation AND x.value=? AND x.entity_id=p.id) p) AND c.entity_id!=? LIMIT 4097),
      total AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT count(*) n FROM eligible),
      ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT c.id,1-min(vec_distance_cosine(coalesce(p.normalized,v.embedding),?)) score,c.seq
        FROM total t CROSS JOIN eligible c JOIN embedding_values v ON v.id=c.embedding_id
        LEFT JOIN embedding_search p ON p.embedding_id=v.id WHERE t.n<=4096
        GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY score DESC,c.seq LIMIT ?)
      SELECT NULL id,NULL score,n,NULL seq FROM total
      UNION ALL SELECT id,score,NULL,seq FROM ranked ORDER BY n DESC,score DESC,seq
